title: Juniper and the Crown
premise: When the wards sealing the godless valley of Hollowmere collapse, mercenary Elodie Quintana discovers her silent patron was never gone — it was imprisoned inside the crown of King Aldric, whose body now serves the usurper Veyra's armies. Guided by a runaway court mage and a disgraced knight who becomes the family she never had, Elodie crosses a starless kingdom to reach the capital. In the throne room, she learns she is Aldric's daughter, bound to the valley at birth to keep her safe from the crown's hunger. She shatters the crown, freeing both god and king at the cost of her own magic, and returns to Hollowmere not as an exile but as the founder of a refuge for others like her.
about_author: Tamsin Lockridge is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing medieval charters before turning to fantasy. She writes about outsiders, oaths, and the families we build when the old ones fail us.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. On watch at the valley border, Elodie feels the wards die and the stars vanish overhead; refugees pour in carrying tales of a king marching on the free cities. When a wounded stranger — the knight Ser Brannoc — collapses at her feet clutching a shard of crown-gold, her silent god stirs for the first time in years. Emotional beat: dread giving way to reluctant purpose as Elodie chooses to leave the only home she's known.

chapters.title: A Company of Strays
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV, with interludes from runaway court mage Wren. The trio crosses the blighted midlands, dodging Veyra's patrols, and Wren reveals the truth: the crown devours kings, and the god inside it has been screaming for decades. Elodie's magic flickers alive outside the valley, terrifying and exhilarating. Emotional beat: friction melting into found family around a smuggler's campfire, as each confesses what they lost to the crown.

chapters.title: The Usurper's Court
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. Disguised as pilgrims, they infiltrate the capital during Veyra's coronation feast. Elodie comes face to face with King Aldric — hollow-eyed, puppeted — and the crown recognizes her blood, whispering her name before the whole court. Captured and interrogated by Veyra, Elodie learns she is the king's hidden daughter and the last key to the crown's prison. Emotional beat: identity shattered and remade; betrayal by Wren, coerced by old debts, breaks Elodie's heart.

chapters.title: Unbinding
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. In the throne room beneath a starless sky, Elodie breaks free with Brannoc's help while Wren, repentant, turns Veyra's own warding against her. Elodie shatters the crown: the god rises free into the relit heavens, Aldric wakes broken but human, and Veyra falls to her own starving magic. Powerless but whole, Elodie leads her ragged family back to Hollowmere to open its gates. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into belonging — home is no longer a place that kept her out.
